opus.problem: Gives the word away. 'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want' is one of the best-known lines in the Bible, so pointing to the opening of David's most famous psalm and quoting 'shall not want' gives the answer at once. It is not medium hard.

Gives the word away. 'The good one of these, who lays down His life for the sheep' is a near-direct quote of the famous 'I am the good shepherd' saying, and 'good shepherd' is itself an accepted answer. It is not medium hard.
